Sign in

Residents and staff sign in here with the account they were given or created.

Email
Password
Sign in

New to the app? Create a resident account.

Who signs in here
Residents use the account they created to report an emergency and follow each report.
Staff (dispatchers, responders, and disaster management officers) use the account their team set up.

Need an account or help signing in? Contact your team’s dispatcher.

Submitting a report through this app does not automatically guarantee immediate rescue. If you are in danger, call your local emergency hotline.

Create a resident account

Fill in the details below. All fields are required.

Name
Email
Phone
Password

At least 8 characters.

Confirm password
Create account

Already registered? Sign in

What you can do
Send a report with photos and your location.
Follow each status change on your reports.
See rounded incident areas near you.
What happens next
Your account is created with the details you enter.
You go straight to your resident page.

If you are in danger, call your local emergency number now. A report does not guarantee immediate rescue.
